title: The bin/wt template that relay setup writes into every…
what: templates/bin-wt:10: LOW: F1 the bin/wt template that relay setup writes into every project still makes wt/queue-<x>; only relay's own copy was fixed
why: The bin/wt template that relay setup copies into every new project still makes wt/queue-<x> branches for a queue- name; relay's own bin/wt was fixed on 30 Oct, so every project set up from now on keeps the bug.
failing_case: A project set up by relay (bin/wt written from templates/bin-wt). The front, told by guard_main to use bin/wt new <name>, runs
bin/wt new queue-docs main there: it makes .worktrees/queue-docs on wt/queue-docs, which relay doctor lists as a leftover queue
branch and tidy and the merge hook skip as a landing branch. Expected: refused as in relay's own bin/wt.
pass_cases: 1. templates/bin-wt rendered (branch=main), run in a temp repo: new queue-docs main -> exit non-zero, stderr names "queue-",
2. Same rendered template: new docs main -> .worktrees/docs on wt/docs, exit 0, prints the path.
3. relay's own bin/wt keeps both behaviours of tests/test_bin_wt.py.
